I've got time to work on this today. agree it feels kind of like adding the #87 approach as supplemental whole file import / export endpoint to the keymanger api. 

is an eip like 3076 needed for the file format or can that be standardized as part of the keymanager api?

author: nflaig
content: I don't see why that would need an EIP, the keymanager api can define the schema, it's also the primary interface for this so seems fine to define it there, of course clients can add cli flags to provide a file in a similar format, but I don't really see a good reason to define that outside the keymanager api. it could be an informational EIP I guess if you wanna propose that too, I am not so sure how informational EIPs work tbh, but you don't need it as part of a fork, it just exists as a reference, leaving this up to you if you wanna work on that 🙂
